description: This file defines a durable, serialized dictionary implementation in C# for use within the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes the interface 'IDurableDictionary' and a class 'DurableDictionary' that handles serialization, versioning, command application, and persistence for a key-value store with durable state capabilities.

classes.name: IDurableDictionary<K, V>
classes.description: A generic interface extending IDictionary with a contract for durable state operations in Orleans.

classes.name: DurableDictionary<K, V>
classes.description: An internal class implementing durable, serializable dictionary with versioning, command handling, and persistence capabilities, supporting operations like add, remove, clear, snapshot, and apply log entries.

classes.name: DebugViewDictionaryItem<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A helper struct for debugging, representing a key-value pair with debugger display attributes.

classes.name: IDurableDictionaryDebugView<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A debugger view class for visualizing the contents of an IDurableDictionary in development tools.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the dictionary to a clean state and assigns a storage writer.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the dictionary state based on serialized commands.

methods.name: ApplySnapshot
methods.description: Reads a snapshot from a log and populates the dictionary accordingly.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all items in the dictionary and logs this action.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the dictionary, logs removal if successful.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the dictionary and logs the addition.

methods.name: TryGetValue
methods.description: Tries to get a value for a key.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the elements to an array.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over key-value pairs.
